newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-DENILSON LOOKS SET TO JOIN BARCELONA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DENILSON LOOKS SET TO JOIN BARCELONA.

text.p: Brazilian international striker Denilson looks poised to join Barcelona, according to Spanish newspaper reports on Wednesday.
El Mundo Deportivo, a Spanish sports daily, reported that Barcelona and Denilson's present club Sao Paulo were close to agreeing terms.
The two clubs are believed to have agreed on a price of around five billion pesetas ($33.3 million) for the forward.
Denilson was one of the stars of Brazil's recent Copa America triumph.
The one remaining obstacle to the deal is understood to be a valuation on Barcelona's Giovanni, who would return to Brazil as part of the deal.
Sao Paulo have offered 1.2 billion pesetas ($8 million) for the disgruntled Brazilian striker while the Catalan giants are reported to value him at two billion pesetas ($13.3 million).
